artworks.title: Woman Dancing with a Parrot
artworks.description: The image shows a person dancing on a checkered floor with one hand extended while a bird is perched on their hand. The person appears focused with their hair covered by a headscarf or hood. They are wearing a flowing gown with intricate patterns and embellishments. The background is dark, creating contrast with the light figure and emphasizing movement and focus on the dance.

artworks.title: Lactuca Perennis
artworks.medium: pressed and dried plant inked and pressed between two sheets of paper
artworks.description: The image features two botanical elements: a stem with buds and a flower, and a large, lobed leaf. The color palette is monochrome, with a soft, earthy tone against a pale background. The stem with the flower is on the left, while the leaf dominates the right side. The text label identifies the plant as "Lactuca perennis."

artworks.title: Hieracium Cymosum
artworks.medium: pressed and dried plant inked and pressed between two sheets of paper
artworks.description: The image contains two botanical drawings of plants, one with a cluster of small flowers at the top and the other with long narrow leaves growing from the base. The color palette is earthy browns on a light beige background. The left illustration shows the flowering plant with umbrella-like clusters at the top, while the other plant with narrow leaves grows upward from the bottom right section of the image.

artworks.title: Carduus Maarianus
artworks.medium: pressed and dried plant inked and pressed between two sheets of paper
artworks.description: The image features a botanical illustration of a thistle identified as "Carduus Marianus." The thistle has a straight, spiny stem and a top flower head with similar spines. The color palette includes shades of brown on a pale, cream background. The thistle is positioned vertically in the center of the image, with thorny leaves along the stem and the largest flower head at the top. Text reading "CLASS. XVIII ORD. I" is at the top left, and "TAB. 438." is at the top right, with the plant name at the bottom right.

artworks.title: Carduus Lanceolatus
artworks.medium: pressed and dried plant inked and pressed between two sheets of paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a tall thistle plant with spiky leaves and blooming flower heads at the top. The color scheme is sepia, giving the illustration a vintage look. The text "CARDUUS LANCEOLATUS" is below the thistle, and other text "CLASS XVIII ORD. I" and "TAB. 629" are at the top corners.

artworks.title: Pteris Aquilina
artworks.medium: pressed and dried plant inked and pressed between two sheets of paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed illustration of a fern leaf with a long, slender stem. The color palette includes muted browns and greys against a cream background. The fern's fronds extend symmetrically from the central stem, forming a triangular shape. The label "PTERIS AQUILINA" is printed at the bottom center, and the top left corner shows "CLASS. XXIIII ORD. I" while the top right corner displays "TAB:1043".

artworks.title: Frieze of Ornament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of foliage and classical figures. The drawing showcases lush foliage intertwined with various figures, some appearing mythological with muscular physiques and dynamic poses. The detailed scene features figures among intricate leaves and swirls, creating movement and interaction. The artwork highlights the interplay between human forms and natural motifs, blending nature and artistry typical of classical decorative art.

artworks.title: Macbeth V (The Vision of Lady Macbeth)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a dark scene with a central figure surrounded by ghostly entities. The central figure wears a crown and a long garment and has an intense expression. Surrounding the figure are various ghostly forms, including skull-like faces. The drawing is detailed and textured, with intricate line work conveying movement and depth. In the foreground, a smaller figure reaches up towards the central figure. Skulls and specter-like figures in the background enhance the eerie atmosphere, creating a haunting visual narrative.

artworks.title: Lycidas
artworks.artist: Frederick Christian Lewis I and Moses Haughton II after Henry Fuseli; published by Moses Haughton II
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper

artworks.title: Dr. C. Hofstede de Groot
artworks.description: The sketch shows a seated man from the waist up. He is relaxed, with his arms crossed over his lap. The man has a prominent forehead, deep-set eyes, and a pointed goatee. His hair is slicked back, suggesting a receding hairline. He is dressed in a suit. The background is plain, drawing attention to the man as the main subject.

artworks.title: Central Park Scenery (New York)
artworks.description: This image features oval vignettes of different scenic spots within Central Park, New York. Each vignette is outlined with a black line and surrounded by a pink background. The view shows various elements of the park, including gazebos, bridges, fountains, and park-goers in miniature. The illustrations are detailed with fine linework and careful brushstrokes, displaying a color palette of pastels, blues, greens, tans, and brick tones. The horizons are set towards the upper part of each oval scene, emphasizing depth and perspective. Handwriting in the lower half of the image reads "Central Park Scenery, New York" along with a seasonal greeting dated December 18, 19th century, from Lucien G. W. Smith.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for Peter Heylyn's "The History of St. George of Cappadocia"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical print depicting St George. The image is structured around a central archway containing the title "The History of That Most Famous Saynt and Souldier of Christ Iesus St. GEORGE of Cappadocia." The drawing is richly detailed, featuring numerous elements of heraldry and ornate text. To the left and right of the main text are armored figures. Above the arch are two busts of crowned figures with elaborate detail in their facial features and royal attire. The image contains crests and heraldic symbols, including a cross enclosed in a circle at the top, surrounded by the motto "Honi soit qui mal y pense." Below the publication information, a small figure of a dragon can be seen. The drawing is finely crafted, showcasing a mastery of line and shading typical of early to mid-17th-century engravings.

artworks.title: Bellona Seated on Her Trophies
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an armored figure reclining beside various military objects. The central figure is shown in profile, wearing a helmet with a plume and armor. The scene includes a shield, various weapons, and drapery. The composition is rendered in fine, intricate lines, which adds a sense of texture and depth to the piece. The background is filled with horizontal lines, providing contrast to the more detailed foreground elements. The scene creates an atmosphere of calm endurance juxtaposed with martial might.

artworks.title: Mars Seated on Trophies
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a reclining figure in a classical setting. The drawing depicts a figure lying with a relaxed posture, draped in flowing garments that are intricately detailed with lines and shading. The figure wears a helmet adorned with a plume and holds an object in one hand. Architectural elements are present, such as a rolled structure resembling a scroll or column at the figure's side. The figure's legs are extended, with one knee bent. The entire scene is framed within an arched border.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.description: This drawing shows an angel descending from the sky towards a seated figure under an archway. The scene features intricate architectural elements, including a grand archway supported by tall columns adorned with ornate capitals. On the left side are swirling clouds, from which the angel emerges towards the seated figure. The angel has wings and draped clothing, while the seated figure is under a canopy-style chair, reading a book. The background includes greenery and architectural structures, adding depth to the composition. The drawing utilizes shading and line work for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Meeting of Mary and Elizabeth
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient architectural structure with Corinthian columns and ornate arches, set in a scenic environment with mountains in the distance and vegetation nearby. The structure is detailed with skilled rendering of perspective and shading to show light and shadow on the stone surfaces.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.description: The image depicts an architectural landscape scene with detailed buildings, columns, and arches on the left side. On the right, there is another building with a staircase leading to an upper level where a sculpted figure can be seen. In the distance, there are hills and misty landscapes. A path between the buildings shows human figures and animals. The etching technique emphasizes intricate lines and textures. The color palette is monochromatic. The scene is filled with human activity.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Kings
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural scene with classical elements and figures gathered around a central staircase. The scene depicts a grand structure with tall columns and arches. In the foreground, there are stairs leading up to a group of figures, and to the right, a series of ornately decorated buildings with intricate details. The skies above have a radiant sun emitting rays. The drawing showcases a high level of detail in both the architecture and the figures, with delicate shading and line work bringing the scene to life.

artworks.title: Presentation in the Temple
artworks.description: The image is depicted from a slightly elevated angle, showing architectural elements and figures. The horizon is not distinctly visible due to the composition, but the architecture leads the eye towards the sky. The artwork features intricate linework characteristic of an etching, with detailed cross-hatching creating depth and texture in the stone structures and figures. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring shades of brown, giving a classic and aged feel. On the left, a column is partially covered with vine leaves, and to its right, a group of figures appear engaged in conversation. Further back, a grand architectural structure with columns and ornate details is seen, with a few additional figures entering the building. The background includes trees and a glimpse of distant hills or mountains.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image features a pastoral scene from an elevated viewpoint. It shows a broad landscape extending into the distance. Near the bottom, a group of figures and animals gather near a rocky outcrop under trees. A stone bridge crosses a body of water. On the horizon, there are rolling hills, trees, and a thatched-roof building. The artwork employs a monochromatic palette of sepia tones and detailed line work, giving it a serene quality.

artworks.title: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile facing right against a textured background. He has a prominent nose, facial hair, and wears glasses and a bowler hat. The man is dressed in a high-collared coat, partially covering his lower face, and appears to be holding an object, possibly an umbrella or a cane, under his arm.

artworks.title: The Early Ploughman
artworks.description: The image is a landscape seen from a ground-level perspective, featuring a scene of pastoral life. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky with expressive brushstrokes depicting clouds. A hill is on the left with a silhouette of what seems to be ruins or a small structure. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of sepia for light and shadow. Two oxen are working the land with a figure guiding them, and tall trees stand on the right with a lone figure nearby. The brushwork is detailed, capturing nature and human activity.

artworks.title: Battle of the Nudes
artworks.medium: engraving with extensive retouching in pen and ink on two joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of warriors in combat amidst a forest setting. The drawing depicts a tumultuous scene where numerous figures are engaged in a battle, wielding weapons. The setting is dense with stylized plant forms and trees. The figures are rendered in a highly detailed manner, displaying muscular anatomy and expressive poses that convey motion. The atmosphere is intense and chaotic, emphasizing the ferocity of the confrontation.

artworks.title: Venus and Amor
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with three cherubic children. The woman has curly hair and a serene expression. She is dressed in draped clothing, with one arm around the cherubs and the other hand near her lips. The cherubs have curly hair as well, with one on her lap, one holding an arrow, and one peeking over her shoulder. The background features outlines of foliage and trees.
